messages:
ashley_billing: FYI invoice INV-4421 for CloudAcme is blocked — vendor sent wrong ratecard. Vendor billed at $0.002/token vs our contracted $0.0002/token, customer invoice now ~ $75k instead of ~ $7.5k :eyes:

sam_fin: Ack. Please paste vendor ref + PO. We need to decide accrual vs hold for month-end close.

ashley_billing: Vendor: DeepServe Inc. Vendor invoice 83921. PO #PO-9933 matches our contract. Discrepancy = $67,500. Vendor used legacy enterprise sku rates by mistake.

maria_ar: tagging AR — we can't collect until vendor reissues. From a RevRec perspective, do we treat as unbilled receivable or set a vendor-credit liability? Need GAAP-preserving approach.

leo_ops: Also heads up this was for Dedicated reserved capacity (start Mar 1). Revenue schedule 2024-Ded-CloudAcme has monthly recognition. If vendor doesn't correct, recognized revenue this month would be overstated.

ashley_billing: Confirmed. If vendor reissues before close we can invoice correctly. If not, we'll need to adjust schedules. I've started a vendor ticket.

sam_fin: Quick proposal: book a vendor-credit liability for the $67,500 difference and keep recognized revenue unchanged until vendor reissues? Or book a contra-revenue accrual now?

maria_ar: I prefer vendor-credit liability (other current liability) and reduce recognized revenue until correction — avoids restatement risk. We'll record a short-term liability and amend the revenue schedule.

ashley_billing: Opening ticket now — VS-7042. Requesting corrected invoice and confirmation of sku mapping.

invoice_bot: Ticket VS-7042 created by ashley_billing at 1719999999. Priority: high.

kate_accounting: I can approve a liability accrual for $67,500 for month-end with full backup. Please draft JE and attach vendor emails + PO.

ashley_billing: Draft JE uploaded to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=12345 (JE template and backup).

maria_ar: Also add an amendment to revenue schedule 2024-Ded-CloudAcme: move the disputed $67,500 from March recognition to deferred until vendor reissue. Note to audit: backup in Confluence.

leo_ops: I'll follow up with billing engine; vendor used old SKU code that maps to legacy ratecard. We'll add a safeguard to flag large price deviations (>10%) on invoice ingestion.

sam_fin: Action items recap: 1) ashley -> vendor ticket VS-7042 and request corrected invoice (due EOD tomorrow) 2) kate -> post JE accrual in NetSuite (JE-55892 draft) 3) maria -> amend revenue schedule and prepare audit note 4) leo_ops -> add billing mapping safeguard + report.

kate_accounting: JE-55892 created in NetSuite (status: Pending). Amount: $67,500. Approver: kate_accounting. Will finalize once vendor doc received.

ashley_billing: Vendor replied: will reissue corrected invoice by EOD tomorrow and include new line item codes.

sam_fin: Good — for month-end we will keep JE-55892 in place as a liability accrual until vendor reissue. If reissue arrives, reverse JE and post correct AR.

ashley_billing: I'll update this thread when vendor reissues. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

maria_ar: Noted. Please cc finance-close@redwood.ai when vendor sends corrected invoice so we can attach to close package.

leo_ops: Filed internal ticket ENG-BILL-1124 to add deviation alert to pipeline.

ashley_billing: Closing note: moving this into 'finance:open' and adding to month-end exceptions. Will update after vendor reissue.

sam_fin: Thanks. We'll treat JE-55892 as the month-end control for this exception.
